message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One confirmed relevant vulnerability and one possible Oracle client match were identified in the last 24 hours for the DLL/component inventory. No new MongoDB-family advisory was found in the same window.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. The primary product-list sources were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-20 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-21 07:40 UTC (2026-10-20 13:10 IST through 2026-10-21 13:10 IST).

### Finding 1: Angular HTTP Client XSRF token leakage

- **Affected product/component:** `@angular/common` HTTP Client; listed ProcessDesigner Angular 8.2.14 and AppWizard Angular 12.2.0 applications
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-111753 / GHSA-jfgx-762w-99vr
- **Severity:** Moderate, CVSS 5.9 (GitHub)
- **Description:** URL parsing differences can cause Angular's HTTP client to attach the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header to an attacker-controlled cross-origin request, potentially exposing the token when the required request and CORS conditions are met.
- **Relevance:** The advisory affects `@angular/common` versions up to 19.2.25, which includes the two Angular versions in the assigned inventory.
- **Source:** [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jfgx-762w-99vr)

### Possible matches needing review

**Oracle Instant Client / ODP.NET - CVE-2026-75803**

- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.8
- **Description:** Oracle's 20 October 2026 Critical Patch Update identifies a TLS/OpenSSL vulnerability in Oracle Database products and states that it applies to client-only installations.
- **Why review is needed:** The inventory contains Oracle Instant Client 11.2.0.1 and Oracle DataAccess/ODP.NET from the 11.2/12.1 era, but Oracle's affected-version matrix lists only supported 19.3-19.32 and 23.4.0-23.26.3 releases. Impact on the listed legacy DLLs is therefore not confirmed.
- **Source:** [Oracle October 2026 Critical Patch Update](https://www.oracle.com/security-alerts/cpuoct2026.html)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, maintained libraries, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD-style records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated during this scan window. The newest item on the [MongoDB Alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) was dated 19 October 2026 and was excluded as outside the window.

### Review priority

Prompt review is recommended for both listed Angular applications because their versions fall within the confirmed affected range. Separately, ask Oracle support or validate through version-specific patch documentation whether CVE-2026-75803 affects the unsupported 11.2/12.1-era client DLLs before treating that possible match as confirmed.
